import { Badge } from '@astrale-os/ui/badge' import { Button } from '@astrale-os/ui/button' import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription } from '@astrale-os/ui/popover' import { Progress } from '@astrale-os/ui/progress' import { Separator } from '@astrale-os/ui/separator' import { StarIcon } from "lucide-react" const ratings = { 1: 0, 2: 15, 3: 30, 4: 30, 5: 225 } const PopoverRatingsDemo = () => { const totalReviews = Object.values(ratings).reduce((acc, count) => acc + count, 0) const totalRating = Object.entries(ratings).reduce((acc, [star, count]) => acc + Number(star) * count, 0) const averageRating = Number((totalRating / totalReviews || 0).toFixed(2)) return ( }> Ratings & reviews
{averageRating}
Total {totalReviews} reviews All reviews are from genuine customers.
